Claude Code

Anthropic's coding agent in the terminal and IDE: stage 0 of our ladder, today.

WHAT IT IS

An agentic coding tool that reads a repository, runs commands and edits files, with permission modes, hooks, MCP connections and subagents. Runs headless with claude -p.

WHAT SETS IT APART

It runs with the engineer's own access and asks before acting, so a human is the gate. Managed settings, project instruction files and hooks encode team conventions and checks once.

WHERE WE STAND

In use. Next: managed settings, telemetry on, and hooks that run our policy checks locally. ⚠️ Check flag names against current docs.
